fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The planner carved leaf commit-trailers out of umbrella Area integrity into this change set and raised one question with three parts: where the unclaimed-changes cutoff lives, which commits count as claimed, and whether this repo turns the rule on now. The arbiter answered with Decision unclaimed-changes-cutoff: the cutoff is a full commit hash in a new committed .rhiza/check.json (repo.json untouched, no file or key means the rule is off, an unresolvable hash is a check error naming the file). The rule reads <cutoff>..HEAD non-merge commits that change a file outside .rhiza/, a commit is claimed when one of its Change: trailers names a change set in the log, and each unclaimed commit gets one warning saying whether the trailer is missing or names an unknown change set. This change set turns the rule on here with the cutoff at the origin/main commit the branch is built on.
fields.title: Plan of Unclaimed changes, autonomous run
